title: Meet Norway
description: Travel to Norway with Spark and Mango: a country in Northern Europe whose capital is Oslo, where people speak Norwegian and pay with the Norwegian krone — plus two places we'd love to visit.

body.heading: Where in the world is Norway?
paragraphs: Norway is a country in Northern Europe, which is part of Europe.

body.heading: The capital city
paragraphs: The capital of Norway is Oslo.

body.heading: Words you might hear
paragraphs: The language you will hear most in Norway is Norwegian. Norwegian is written in two official forms, Bokmål and Nynorsk — schoolchildren learn both!

body.heading: Money in your pocket
paragraphs: The money of Norway is the Norwegian krone.

body.heading: How big is Norway?
paragraphs: Norway covers about 385,000 square kilometres of land and inland water. That makes it about three times the size of Greece.

body.heading: A fact to wow your friends
paragraphs: Norway’s coastal fjords were carved by glaciers over long periods. The fjords are so deep and steep that villages at their heads are reached by boat or by tunnels through the mountains.

body.heading: Two places we'd love to visit
paragraphs: Geirangerfjord is Norway's postcard fjord — waterfalls like the Seven Sisters pour down cliffs to a tiny village at the head of deep blue water.
Tromsø is the capital of the Arctic — ride its cable car, meet huskies and, in winter, watch the aurora dance over the snow.

body.heading: Think and talk
paragraphs: 1. Find Norway on a map or globe. Which continent is it on — and can you name a country that sits next to it?
2. Spark and Mango can visit only ONE of the two places in this article. Which should they choose — and what would you pack for the trip?

takeaway: Norway in one breath: a country in Northern Europe, capital Oslo, where people speak Norwegian and pay with the Norwegian krone.
